start: Settings, a member in a gym, online

steps.action: Open Settings, Help, tap 'Help and feedback'
user_sees: Title 'Help and feedback'
'Ask a question and get an answer at once. Or tell us what works, what is hard, or what you want next. Tap Speak and talk, or type.'
A box 'Type here, or tap Speak'
'Send' greyed out while the box is empty
must_not: Send tappable with an empty box

steps.action: Type a question and tap 'Send'
user_sees: 'Sending. The answer usually takes a few seconds.'
The box empties
must_not: Two messages from a double tap
The typed text lost when sending fails

steps.action: Look at 'Your questions' below
user_sees: The question with a 'Quick answer' marked 'automatic' and 'Answer written by AI from our help pages.'
'Did this solve it?' with 'Yes' and 'No'
must_not: An answer to another member's question
No answer and no 'Waiting for the answer' line

start: Help and feedback, the member prefers to talk

steps.action: Tap Speak and say the message, then 'Send'
user_sees: The spoken words typed into the box
After sending: the question in 'Your questions'
must_not: The message sent as typed when it was spoken (input lost)
Sending before the member taps Send

start: Any screen, the round feedback button showing

steps.action: Tap the round button 'Send feedback about this screen'
user_sees: 'Ask about this screen and get an answer at once, or tell us what is wrong here.'
'To turn off this round button: Settings → "Help and feedback".'
must_not: The message saved against the wrong screen

start: Help and feedback, a member with a MettleUp watch log on the phone

steps.action: Turn on 'Add my watch's screen log', type a message, tap 'Send'
user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message. Your watch screen log was sent too.' (or only the watch line after an answer)
The switch turns itself off after sending
must_not: The log sent without the switch on
A success line when the log failed: must say 'Your message was sent, but the watch screen log was not. Try again later.'

start: Help and feedback with the internet off

steps.action: Type a message and tap 'Send'
user_sees: 'Couldn't send. Check your internet and try again. Your message is still here.'
The text still in the box
must_not: The box emptied
'Thanks! We read every message.' shown

steps.action: Type only spaces
user_sees: 'Send' stays greyed out
must_not: An empty message sent

start: Help and feedback, a member with no gym

steps.action: Type a question and tap 'Send'
user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message.' or an answer; 'The MettleUp team will reply here.' under the question
must_not: A gym's AI credits spent for a member with no gym
An error because there is no gym key

start: Your questions, a question sent earlier

steps.action: Tap 'No' under 'Did this solve it?'
user_sees: 'You said this did not solve it. The MettleUp team will reply here.'
must_not: The question gone from the list

steps.action: Later the team replies; open Help and feedback
user_sees: 'Reply from the MettleUp team' with a 'New' badge
must_not: The reply shown on another member's phone
The 'New' badge staying after it was read

start: Help and feedback, the floating button switch

steps.action: Turn off 'Show the feedback button on every screen'
user_sees: The round button gone from every screen
must_not: The button back after reopening the app

steps.action: Turn it on again
user_sees: The round button back
must_not: The switch on but no button

start: Help and feedback, a member in a gym

steps.action: Send a question
user_sees: Only the member and the MettleUp team see the question and its answers
must_not: The gym owner seeing the member's question text
The gym's member key sent to the AI or saved
